fixture_contract.name: blg-d05-denmarcs-reconciliation-v1
fixture_contract.reset: Restore versioned synthetic local database snapshot and task-local queue before each case; use a unique case idempotency key; delete only case-local namespace after evidence capture. External egress and live data are forbidden.

coverage.requirement: C1 AC02 ambiguity and lineage fail closed
C1 AC05 replay and changed evidence
C2 AC05 generic foreign apply denial

cases.title: Unique same-tenant evidence creates non-mutating confirmed proposal
cases.fixture: one available synthetic code, normalized GTIN match, one current target, approved OLD lineage
steps: Build C1 inventory.
Read proposal and source totals.
cases.expected_transaction: No code, ownership, link or lifecycle mutation occurs.
cases.expected_db: One append-only proposed decision has masked evidence and CONFIRMED_LINK classification.
cases.read_back: Source total equals classified plus skipped total; code remains excluded from allocation until C2.
cases.reload_assertion: Rebuilt inventory returns the same decision identity.

cases.title: Ambiguous or unapproved lineage never gets an inferred target
cases.fixture: parameterized missing, duplicate, conflicting candidates and OLD relation without approved lineage
steps: Build C1 inventory for each ambiguity variant.
Read proposed target and reason.
cases.expected_db: Every row is REVIEW_REQUIRED with an explicit reason and no target reference.
cases.read_back: No link, availability or lifecycle value changes.
cases.oracle: C1 AC02; SKU/name/prefix are not proof.

cases.title: Foreign lookalike is absent and undisclosed from C1 candidates
cases.fixture: identical GTIN/SKU/barcode/name exists only in tenant-b/seller-b
steps: Request tenant-a inventory.
Inspect candidates, response and masked audit.
cases.expected_authorization: Foreign record has no existence-disclosing response or audit field.
cases.read_back: Tenant-a has no foreign candidate; tenant-b state is byte-for-byte unchanged for the case surface.
cases.oracle: tenant_sensitive negative authorization and C1 AC03.

cases.title: Consumed or otherwise ineligible lifecycle code is retained and skipped
cases.fixture: reserved, printed, applied, introduced, transferred, shipped, defective, replaced and void synthetic codes
steps: Build C1 inventory.
Read classification and historical events for every lifecycle state.
cases.expected_db: Each row has explicit skipped/non-action reason; no event or provenance is rewritten.
cases.read_back: All historical lifecycle/link evidence remains intact and code remains non-actionable.
cases.oracle: C1 AC04 and marking-code lifecycle invariant.

cases.title: Replay is stable while changed evidence invalidates approval append-only
cases.fixture: unique candidate then changed target evidence/source hash
steps: Build inventory twice with identical input.
Change evidence hash and rebuild.
Inspect decision lineage and approval validity.
cases.expected_db: Identical input adds no duplicate audit fact; changed input appends a new decision and invalidates stale approval.
cases.read_back: Only current decision can later be applied.
cases.oracle: C1 AC05 and append-only audit invariant.

cases.title: Paged population reconciles with masked evidence and no allocation side effect
cases.fixture: 257 synthetic codes across confirmed, review and skipped classes with non-sensitive masked tokens
steps: Build paged inventory.
Traverse all pages.
Reconcile totals and inspect output/audit for raw values.
cases.expected_db: Every source row appears exactly once in a terminal classification; no availability changes.
cases.read_back: Confirmed plus review plus skipped equals 257; raw CIS/DataMatrix is absent from response, audit and trace.
cases.oracle: C1 total reconciliation and raw-code protection.

cases.title: Approved current row applies once and read-back alone reaches allocation eligibility
cases.fixture: C1-approved current eligible unique row with valid approval and unchanged evidence
steps: Apply approved decision with idempotency key.
Read code, allocation predicate and audit after commit.
cases.expected_transaction: One atomic per-code mutation commits only after all mutation-time checks pass.
cases.expected_db: One link/classification and before/after append-only audit exist.
cases.read_back: Stored link, owner, lifecycle and allocation predicate match approved target; no other code becomes eligible.

cases.title: Quarantined row is excluded from allocation, FBS scan and replacement selection
cases.fixture: REVIEW_REQUIRED, missing approval and unreadable decision variants
steps: Attempt allocation query, FBS scan path and replacement selection for each quarantined code.
Read code and audit afterward.
cases.expected_authorization: No unauthorized selection path reveals or promotes the code.
cases.expected_db: No product link or availability is created; exclusion reason remains durable.
cases.read_back: All three consumers reject the row and no lifecycle/event changes.

cases.title: Stale or concurrently reserved row stops while independent valid row proceeds
cases.fixture: two approved rows; mutate one target ownership/evidence/lifecycle and reserve it between preview and apply
steps: Create valid preview.
Change one row through deterministic concurrent barrier.
Apply batch and read both rows.
cases.expected_transaction: Changed row commits no reconciliation mutation; independent current row may commit once.
cases.expected_db: Stopped row has explicit stale/concurrency reason and remains excluded.
cases.read_back: No consumed/reserved history is overwritten; valid row result is independent.
cases.oracle: C2 AC03, mutation-time recheck and lifecycle invariant.

cases.title: Mixed batch crash retry and duplicate execution reconcile atomically per code
cases.fixture: three approved rows: success, forced mutation failure, and row interrupted after commit before acknowledgement
cases.fixture_builder: fault-injection local snapshot and task-local queue
steps: Start batch with forced failure/crash points.
Retry with same idempotency key and then a duplicate request.
Reconcile row statuses, audit and totals.
cases.expected_transaction: Success commits once; failed row is stopped/quarantined; post-commit retry does not duplicate link or audit fact.
cases.expected_db: Every row has one reconciled terminal result and masked error trace where relevant.
cases.read_back: Counts equal one applied, one stopped and one recovered applied; no row is silently lost.
cases.oracle: C2 AC04; idempotency and partial-failure contract.

cases.title: Foreign apply receives generic denial and mutates neither tenant
cases.fixture: tenant-b approved decision/code identifier supplied under tenant-a credentials
steps: Submit foreign identifier from tenant-a context.
Inspect response, audit and both tenant states.
cases.expected_authorization: Generic denial has no foreign existence, product, seller or code detail.
cases.expected_db: No mutation, audit ownership leak or availability change occurs in either tenant.
cases.read_back: Tenant-a and tenant-b reconciliation states are unchanged.
cases.oracle: C2 AC05 and tenant_sensitive isolation receipt.

cases.title: Reassignment appends superseding decision without rewriting history
cases.fixture: previously applied eligible link then separately approved correction to new canonical target
cases.fixture_builder: local snapshot with prior applied audit
steps: Apply approved correction.
Read old/new decisions, events and active link.
cases.expected_db: New reviewed decision references superseded decision; prior audit/events remain immutable.
cases.read_back: Only newly approved active target is used, with complete lineage.

cases.title: Legacy unclassified rows remain compatible and reconciliation integrity is exact
cases.fixture: legacy NULL/unclassified shared-pool rows plus classified rows across products
cases.fixture_builder: pre-change schema snapshot migrated in local harness
steps: Migrate local legacy snapshot.
Run inventory/apply predicates and integrity reconciliation.
cases.expected_db: Legacy NULL/shared-pool semantics remain unchanged; classified rows use new fail-closed predicate only.
cases.read_back: Population, links and append-only history reconcile before and after migration.
cases.oracle: S13 compatibility decision and database_change integrity proof.

cases.title: Restore removes only safe reconciliation surface and skips post-use history
cases.fixture: one newly applied unused code and one code with post-apply operational use/event
cases.fixture_builder: migrated local snapshot with two restore branches
steps: Run approved restore rehearsal.
Read both codes, audit/event history and unresolved population.
cases.expected_transaction: Restore is compensating and additive; it never deletes codes or rewrites events.
cases.expected_db: Unused new reconciliation surface is removed/reclassified safely; post-use branch is skipped and retained with reason.
cases.read_back: Both codes remain traceable, unresolved rows remain retained and all historical operational evidence survives.
